557: def _headers_and_records(path: Path, source: Mapping[str, Any], bundle: ConversionBundle) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
558:     openpyxl = _excel_module()
559:     # Keep formula text in the source record while also reading Excel's cached
560:     # result for numeric facts. openpyxl does not calculate formulas itself.
561:     wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=False)
562:     cached_wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
563:     rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
564:     try:
565:         for sheet_index, sheet in enumerate(wb.worksheets):
566:             cached_sheet = cached_wb.worksheets[sheet_index]
567:             width = sheet.max_column
568:             # A title/merged heading often precedes the table. Prefer the
569:             # densest of the first 20 populated rows, while retaining every
570:             # populated row with its original locator below.
571:             populated = [(n, [cell.value for cell in sheet[n]])
572:                          for n in range(1, min(sheet.max_row, 20) + 1)
573:                          if _nonempty(cell.value for cell in sheet[n])]
574:             def header_score(values: Sequence[Any]) -> tuple[float, int, int]:
575:                 nonempty_count = sum(1 for value in values if value is not None and str(value).strip())
576:                 score = 0.0
577:                 for value in values:
578:                     if value is None:
579:                         continue
580:                     normalized = normalize_header(value)
581:                     if any(normalized in aliases for aliases in HEADER_ALIASES.values()):
582:                         score += 4
583:                     # Product/derivative headings are the column schema in
584:                     # BMW's wide study sheets, even when no literal "model"
585:                     # header exists.
586:                     if _line(value):
587:                         score += 6
588:                     if _year(value) is not None or _region(value) is not None:
589:                         score += 2
590:                     if normalized in {str(number) for number in range(1, 8)}:
591:                         score += 1
592:                     if any(label in normalized for label in
593:                            ("satisfied", "dissatisfied", "agree", "disagree", "important", "quality", "rating")):
594:                         score += 1
595:                 return score, nonempty_count, -len(values)
596: 
597:             header_row = max(populated, key=lambda item: header_score(item[1]))[0] if populated else 1
598:             headers = _header_map([cell.value for cell in sheet[header_row]])
599:             header_values = [cell.value for cell in sheet[header_row]]
600:             header_context = [
601:                 {"row": row_num, "values": [json_value(value) for value in values]}
602:                 for row_num, values in populated if row_num <= header_row
603:             ]
604:             question_label = (str(header_values[0]).strip()
605:                               if header_values and header_values[0] is not None else None)
606:             # Iterate the read-only worksheet once instead of calling
607:             # ``sheet.cell`` for every cell, which repeatedly scans the XML.
608:             formula_rows = sheet.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=sheet.max_row,
609:                                            min_col=1, max_col=width, values_only=True)
610:             cached_rows = cached_sheet.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=sheet.max_row,
611:                                                  min_col=1, max_col=width, values_only=True)
612:             for row_num, (values, cached_values) in enumerate(
613:                     zip(formula_rows, cached_rows, strict=True), start=1):
614:                 cells = list(values)
615:                 cached_cells = list(cached_values)
616:                 if not _nonempty(cells):
617:                     continue
618:                 source_record = _row_source_record(source, sheet.title, row_num, headers, cells)
619:                 source_record["raw_payload"]["header_context"] = header_context
620:                 source_record["record_kind"] = "table_header" if row_num == header_row else "original_row"
621:                 bundle.source_records.append(source_record)
622:                 if row_num <= header_row:
623:                     continue
624:                 first_value = cells[0] if cells else None
625:                 has_numeric = any(
626:                     _effective_numeric(value, cached_cells[index] if index < len(cached_cells) else None)[0] is not None
627:                     for index, value in enumerate(cells)
628:                 )
629:                 measure_label = (str(first_value).strip()
630:                                  if has_numeric and first_value is not None and str(first_value).strip()
631:                                  else None)
632:                 if not has_numeric and first_value is not None and str(first_value).strip():
633:                     question_label = str(first_value).strip()
634:                 rows.append({"sheet": sheet.title, "row_num": row_num, "headers": headers,
635:                              "header_values": header_values, "cells": cells,
636:                              "cached_cells": cached_cells, "question_label": question_label,
637:                              "measure_label": measure_label, "record": source_record})
638:     finally:
639:         wb.close()
640:         cached_wb.close()
641:     return rows

644: def _effective_numeric(raw_value: Any, cached_value: Any) -> tuple[int | float | None, str]:
645:     """Return a numeric source value and whether it came from a formula cache."""
646:     if isinstance(raw_value, str) and raw_value.startswith("="):
647:         return _numeric(cached_value), "cached_formula_result"
648:     return _numeric(raw_value), "source_numeric_cell"

665: def _convert_survey_rows(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], source: Mapping[str, Any], bundle: ConversionBundle) -> None:
666:     for row in rows:
667:         headers, cells = row["headers"], row["cells"]
668:         cached_cells = row.get("cached_cells", cells)
669:         respondent_n_value = _numeric(_alias_value(headers, cells, "respondent_n"))
670:         respondent_n = int(respondent_n_value) if respondent_n_value is not None and respondent_n_value >= 0 else None
671:         raw_scale = _alias_value(headers, cells, "scale")
672:         scale = str(raw_scale).strip() if raw_scale is not None and str(raw_scale).strip() else None
673:         raw_unit = _alias_value(headers, cells, "unit")
674:         # Some BMW sheets put a measure label such as "% of column, sample
675:         # base" in the second cell rather than a named column.
676:         if raw_unit is None and len(cells) > 1 and isinstance(cells[1], str):
677:             raw_unit = cells[1]
678:         unit = str(raw_unit).strip() if raw_unit is not None and str(raw_unit).strip() else None
679:         question = row.get("question_label")
680:         measure_label = row.get("measure_label")
681:         numeric_cells = []
682:         for index, raw_value in enumerate(cells):
683:             cached_value = cached_cells[index] if index < len(cached_cells) else None
684:             value, value_provenance = _effective_numeric(raw_value, cached_value)
685:             if value is not None:
686:                 numeric_cells.append((index, value, value_provenance))
687:         if not numeric_cells:
688:             continue
689:         # Preserve every numeric cell as a native fact, including scales and
690:         # percentages. No cross-scale averaging or respondent-N inference.
691:         for index, value, value_provenance in numeric_cells:
692:             column_header = headers[index] if index < len(headers) else f"column_{index + 1}"
693:             model, region = _survey_column_scope(row, index)
694:             metric_parts = [part for part in (question, measure_label) if part]
695:             metric = " / ".join(dict.fromkeys(metric_parts)) or str(column_header)
696:             cell_locator = {**row["record"]["locator"], "column": index + 1,
697:                             "column_header": column_header}
698:             bundle.facts.append(_fact(
699:                 source, row["record"], "survey_cell", cell_locator,
700:                 metric=metric, question=question, response_label=measure_label,
701:                 value=value, unit=unit, scale=scale,
702:                 derivative=model, region=region, respondent_n=respondent_n,
703:                 interpretation="native_cell_unmapped", mapping_strength="unmapped",
704:                 source_value=json_value(cells[index]), value_provenance=value_provenance,
705:             ))
706: 
707:         # Recognize a seven-column 1..7 distribution only when those native
708:         # category labels are explicit in the workbook header.
709:         category_positions: list[int] = []
710:         for index, header in enumerate(row["header_values"]):
711:             if str(header).strip() in {"1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7"}:
712:                 category_positions.append(index)
713:         if len(category_positions) == 7 and category_positions == list(range(category_positions[0], category_positions[0] + 7)):
714:             values = [
715:                 _effective_numeric(
716:                     cells[index] if index < len(cells) else None,
717:                     cached_cells[index] if index < len(cached_cells) else None,
718:                 )[0]
719:                 for index in category_positions
720:             ]
721:             if all(value is not None for value in values):
722:                 question_labels = [str(value).strip() for value in cells[:category_positions[0]]
723:                                    if isinstance(value, str) and str(value).strip()]
724:                 question = " / ".join(question_labels) or row["sheet"]
725:                 distribution = {str(row["header_values"][index]): value
726:                                 for index, value in zip(category_positions, values)}
727:                 locators = [{**row["record"]["locator"], "column": index + 1,
728:                              "column_header": str(row["header_values"][index])}
729:                             for index in category_positions]
730:                 bundle.facts.append(_fact(
731:                     source, row["record"], "survey_distribution",
732:                     {**row["record"]["locator"], "cells": locators},
733:                     metric=question, question=question, distribution=distribution,
734:                     distribution_total=sum(values), distribution_kind="native_unclassified", unit=unit,
735:                     category_labels=[str(row["header_values"][index]) for index in category_positions],
736:                     respondent_n=respondent_n,
737:                     scale=scale or "1-7 (explicit native category headers)",
738:                     scale_provenance="explicit_source_column" if scale else "derived_from_explicit_category_headers",
739:                     derivative=model, region=region,
740:                     mapping_strength="unmapped",
741:                     note="Seven native categories preserved; total is not interpreted as respondent N.",
742:                 ))
743: 
744:     _add_native_survey_distributions(rows, source, bundle)
745:

747: def _add_native_survey_distributions(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
748:                                      source: Mapping[str, Any], bundle: ConversionBundle) -> None:
749:     """Bundle seven source response rows without inventing N or a mapped topic."""

"""Canonical root configuration. Shared with Role 3 at integration."""
from functools import lru_cache
import os
from pathlib import Path

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, REDACTED, field_validator

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


class Settings(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")
    openai_api_key: REDACTED
    openai_model: str = Field(min_length=1)
    raw_data_dir: Path
    data_dir: Path
    output_dir: Path
    cache_dir: Path
    neo4j_uri: str
    neo4j_user: str
    neo4j_password: REDACTED
    api_host: str
    api_port: int = Field(ge=1, le=65535)
    api_base_url: str
    streamlit_server_address: str
    streamlit_server_port: int = Field(ge=1, le=65535)

    @field_validator("api_base_url")
    @classmethod
    def http_origin(cls, value: str) -> str:
        from urllib.parse import urlsplit
        parsed = urlsplit(value)
        if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed.hostname:
            raise ValueError("API_BASE_URL must be an HTTP(S) URL")
        if parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
            raise ValueError("API_BASE_URL must not contain credentials, query, or fragment")
        if parsed.port is not None and not 1 <= parsed.port <= 65535:
            raise ValueError("API_BASE_URL port out of range")
        return value.rstrip("/")


def load_settings() -> Settings:
    load_dotenv(REPO_ROOT / ".env", override=False)

    def path(name: str, default: str) -> Path:
        value = Path(os.environ.get(name, default)).expanduser()
        return (REPO_ROOT / value).resolve() if not value.is_absolute() else value.resolve()

    port = os.environ.get("API_PORT", "8000")
    return Settings(
        openai_api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY", ""),
        openai_model=os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-5.4"),
        raw_data_dir=path("BMW_RAW_DATA_DIR", "./BMW-Data"),
        data_dir=path("BMW_DATA_DIR", "./var/processed"),
        output_dir=path("BMW_OUTPUT_DIR", "./var/exports"),
        cache_dir=path("BMW_CACHE_DIR", "./var/cache"),
        neo4j_uri=os.environ.get("NEO4J_URI", "bolt://localhost:7687"),
        neo4j_user=os.environ.get("NEO4J_USER", "neo4j"),
        neo4j_password=os.environ.get("NEO4J_PASSWORD", "bmwpassword"),
        api_host=os.environ.get("API_HOST", "0.0.0.0"), api_port=port,
        api_base_url=os.environ.get("API_BASE_URL", f"http://localhost:{port}"),
        streamlit_server_address=os.environ.get("STREAMLIT_SERVER_ADDRESS", "0.0.0.0"),
        streamlit_server_port=os.environ.get("STREAMLIT_SERVER_PORT", "8501"),
    )


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_settings() -> Settings:
    return load_settings()

I’ve added the missing dependency, wired the scripts to root configuration, and added an encrypted-PDF regression test.

+                "API_PORT=8123\n"

+
+        self.assertEqual(settings.api_port, 8345)

+        self.assertEqual(settings.data_dir, root / "explicit-output")

+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPO_ROOT) as temp_dir:

1: """Compute topic and issue statistics using distinct canonical comments."""
2: 
3: from __future__ import annotations
4: 
5: import json
6: import hashlib
7: from pathlib import Path
8: import sys
9: from typing import Any
10: 
11: sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
12: 
13: from config import get_settings  # noqa: E402
14: 
15: 
16: TOPIC_QUERY = """
17: MATCH (fb:CustomerFeedback)-[:HAS_ANNOTATION]->(a:FeedbackAnnotation)
18: WHERE a.vfc2_original IS NOT NULL
19: WITH fb.model AS model, fb.region AS region, fb.powertrain AS powertrain,
20:      a.vfc2_original AS topic, fb.id AS feedback_id,
21:      collect(DISTINCT a) AS annotations
22: WITH model, region, powertrain, topic,
23:       count(DISTINCT feedback_id) AS distinct_comments,
24:       collect(DISTINCT feedback_id) AS feedback_ids,
25:      sum(size(annotations)) AS annotation_count,
26:      count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN any(a IN annotations WHERE a.polarity = 'positive') THEN feedback_id END) AS positive_comments,
27:      count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN any(a IN annotations WHERE a.polarity = 'negative') THEN feedback_id END) AS negative_comments,
28:      count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN any(a IN annotations WHERE a.polarity = 'request') THEN feedback_id END) AS request_comments
29: RETURN model, region, powertrain, topic, distinct_comments, annotation_count,
30:        positive_comments, negative_comments, request_comments, feedback_ids
31: ORDER BY model, region, powertrain, topic
32: """
33: 
34: ISSUE_QUERY = """
35: MATCH (fb:CustomerFeedback)-[:HAS_ANNOTATION]->(a:FeedbackAnnotation)
36: WHERE a.vfc3_original IS NOT NULL
37: WITH fb.model AS model, fb.region AS region, fb.powertrain AS powertrain,
38:      a.vfc2_original AS topic, a.vfc3_original AS issue, fb.id AS feedback_id,
39:      collect(DISTINCT a) AS annotations
40: WITH model, region, powertrain, topic, issue,
41:       count(DISTINCT feedback_id) AS distinct_comments,
42:       collect(DISTINCT feedback_id) AS feedback_ids,
43:      sum(size(annotations)) AS annotation_count,
44:      count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN any(a IN annotations WHERE a.polarity = 'positive') THEN feedback_id END) AS positive_comments,
45:      count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN any(a IN annotations WHERE a.polarity = 'negative') THEN feedback_id END) AS negative_comments,
46:      count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN any(a IN annotations WHERE a.polarity = 'request') THEN feedback_id END) AS request_comments
47: RETURN model, region, powertrain, topic, issue, distinct_comments, annotation_count,
48:        positive_comments, negative_comments, request_comments, feedback_ids
49: ORDER BY model, region, powertrain, topic, issue
50: """
51: 
52: 
53: def _data(result: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
54:     return [row.data() if hasattr(row, "data") else dict(row) for row in result]
55: 
56: 
57: def _persist(session: Any, rows: list[dict[str, Any]], level: str) -> None:
58:     records = []
59:     for row in rows:
60:         identity = [level, row.get("model"), row.get("region"), row.get("powertrain"),
61:                     row.get("topic"), row.get("issue")]
62:         key = "|".join("" if part is None else str(part) for part in identity)
63:         node_id = "VFC-" + hashlib.sha256(key.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
64:         properties = {key: value for key, value in row.items() if key != "feedback_ids"}
65:         record = {**properties, "id": node_id, "level": level,
66:                   "rates_json": json.dumps({
67:                       "positive": row["positive_comments"] / row["distinct_comments"] if row["distinct_comments"] else None,
68:                       "negative": row["negative_comments"] / row["distinct_comments"] if row["distinct_comments"] else None,
69:                       "request": row["request_comments"] / row["distinct_comments"] if row["distinct_comments"] else None,
70:                   }, sort_keys=True),
71:                   "interpretation": "within_dataset_mention_counts_not_population_prevalence"}
72:         records.append({"id": node_id, "properties": record, "feedback_ids": row["feedback_ids"]})
73: 
74:     # Reuse the membership obtained by aggregation instead of rescanning the
75:     # whole annotation graph in a separate transaction for every group.
76:     for offset in range(0, len(records), 250):
77:         session.run("""
78:             UNWIND $rows AS row
79:             MERGE (stats:VFCAnalysis {id: row.id})
80:             SET stats += row.properties
81:             WITH stats, row
82:             UNWIND row.feedback_ids AS feedback_id
83:             MATCH (fb:CustomerFeedback {id: feedback_id})
84:             MERGE (stats)-[:SUMMARIZES]->(fb)
85:         """, rows=records[offset:offset + 250]).consume()
86: 
87: 
88: def analyze(session: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
89:     topic_rows = _data(session.run(TOPIC_QUERY))
90:     issue_rows = _data(session.run(ISSUE_QUERY))
91:     _persist(session, topic_rows, "topic")
92:     _persist(session, issue_rows, "issue")
93:     return {"topics": len(topic_rows), "issues": len(issue_rows),
94:             "counting_rule": "DISTINCT canonical feedback IDs; annotation count is separate.",
95:             "rate_interpretation": "Within-dataset annotations, not population preference or prevalence."}
96: 
97: 
98: def main() -> int:
99:     try:
100:         settings = get_settings()
101:     except ValueError as exc:
102:         print(f"Invalid runtime configuration: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
103:         return 2
104:     uri, user, password = settings.neo4j_uri, settings.neo4j_user, settings.neo4j_password.get_secret_value()
105:     if not all((uri, user, password)):
106:         print("Set NEO4J_URI, NEO4J_USER, and NEO4J_PASSWORD before running.")
107:         return 2
108:     try:
109:         from neo4j import GraphDatabase
110:     except ImportError:
111:         print("Neo4j driver is missing; install pipeline/requirements-data.txt")
112:         return 2
113:     driver = GraphDatabase.driver(uri, auth=(user, password))
114:     try:
115:         driver.verify_connectivity()
116:         with driver.session() as session:
117:             summary = analyze(session)
118:     except Exception as exc:
119:         print(f"VFC analysis failed: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
120:         return 1
121:     finally:
122:         driver.close()
123:     print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
124:     return 0
125: 
126: 
127: if __name__ == "__main__":
128:     raise SystemExit(main())

158: ## Neo4j entities and evidence queries
159: 
160: - `SourceFile` stores filename, content hash, kind, and conversion version.
161: - `SourceRecord` stores the exact workbook row or extracted PDF page payload plus a JSON locator. Facts, comments, annotations, and document chunks resolve back to these records.
162: - `CustomerFeedback` stores canonical comment text and original/normalized scope values. `FeedbackAnnotation` stores imported type and VFC2/VFC3 labels separately, so a comment can carry positive and negative annotations at distinct topics.
163: - `Fact` stores native survey cells/distributions and sourced sales values. Nested values and locators are JSON strings, while scope and measure fields remain scalar Neo4j properties.
164: - `DocumentChunk` stores exact page text and a physical page number.
165: - `StudyTopicMapping` is created only from a supplied, reviewed mapping file. Start from `pipeline/study_topic_mappings.example.json`, add exact `fact_ids`, relation (`direct`, `broad`, `contradictory`, or `unmapped`), reason, reviewer, and review time, then load with `--study-mappings <file>`. Mappings to a fact from another converted bundle are rejected.
166: 
167: `services.evidence` exports `EvidenceScope`, typed DTOs, and the `search_feedback`, `get_source_record`, `get_survey_facts`, `get_sales_facts`, `search_document_chunks`, and `get_comment_cohort_counts` providers. Construct `Neo4jEvidenceProvider(driver)` or configure the application-scoped provider. Search results include stable IDs, source hash/version, original text/value, exact row/cell/page locator, applicable scope, and unknowns. Provider/database failures raise `EvidenceProviderError`; they are not returned as empty evidence.
168: 
169: Fact `source_locator` values include the original column/cell metadata, not just
170: the parent row locator. Reviewed study mapping relations are exposed through
171: `mapping_strength`; an unmapped study stays explicitly unmapped.
172: 
173: Example service usage from the backend (the backend owns driver lifecycle):
174: 
175: ```python
176: from services.evidence import EvidenceScope, Neo4jEvidenceProvider
177: 
178: provider = Neo4jEvidenceProvider(driver)
179: quotes = provider.search_feedback(
180:     "seat ventilation", EvidenceScope(model="G70", region="US"), limit=10
181: )
182: study = provider.get_survey_facts(
183:     "seat ventilation", EvidenceScope(model="G70", region="US")
184: )
185: ```
186: 
187: Until the second call has a reviewed mapping, it returns an explicit `unmapped` state instead of treating a keyword match as corroboration. Use the quote's `source_records` locator or `get_source_record(id)` to resolve the original workbook row.
188: 
189: Counts distinguish unique canonical comments from annotations. Topic and issue counts are separate; broad bucket counts must not be reused as narrow issue support. Source A–D values stay opaque. `pipeline/02_build_kg.py` stores source-rate differences as descriptive records and same-VFC3 mixed polarity as a review candidate. It deliberately creates no formal preference-conflict edge: that requires a reviewed preference metric, not just a source-rate gap or opposing broad feedback labels.
190: 
191: ## Verified local acceptance and current limits
192: 
193: Local verification on 2026-10-11 used Python 3.14.7, Neo4j Community 5.26.31,
194: Neo4j driver 6.4.0, pypdf 6.20.0 and conversion version **1.2.1**. The full command
195: above passed **24 tests with no skips**, including four live Neo4j tests.
196: 
197: | Model | Original feedback rows | Distinct canonical comments | Imported annotations |
198: | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
199: | F70 | 4,076 | 2,128 | 4,076 |
200: | G60 | 5,005 | 4,000 | 4,805 |
201: | G70 | 4,690 | 4,000 | 4,490 |
202: | **Total** | **13,771** | **10,128** | **13,371** |
203: 
204: Rows without labels remain source rows; annotations are not invented to make
205: their count equal the row count. The successful complete bundle has **9 source
206: files, 15,304 source records, 2,075 facts and 605 document chunks**. The facts
207: include 36 sales facts and 2,039 native study facts. Summary generation produced
208: 1,430 topic/cohort summaries, 3,439 issue/cohort summaries and 577 descriptive
209: source-rate differences, with no formal preference-conflict edges.
210: 
211: Manual checks compared feedback, sales and study cells, all seven cells of a
212: native US distribution, a corporate-report passage and an option-catalog
213: passage directly with the original workbooks/PDFs. All nine raw-file SHA-256
214: values matched their conversion records. Reimport preserved every node and
215: relationship count, injected audit failure rolled back all new evidence, and
216: the imported corpus survived a Neo4j container restart. Private citation details
217: are available locally in `var/cache/role1-local-verification.json`; source files
218: and derived evidence remain ignored by Git.
219: 
220: The generic workbook adapters preserve uncertain layouts. Native survey cells
221: that lack recognizable seven-category headers remain raw cell facts; sales cells
222: lacking an explicit line/region/year remain source rows. Reviewed study-topic
223: mappings have not been populated for this local import, so topic requests return
224: an explicit `unmapped` state. The source has no China free-text cohort; that is
225: a coverage gap. G60/G68 sales remain one whole-line proxy with no inferred
226: derivative or powertrain split, and document market/derivative applicability
227: remains unknown until reviewed. These provider states are part of the handoff
228: to Roles 3 and 2.

+"""Canonical root environment reader shared by the data and application layers."""
+
+from functools import lru_cache
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+from urllib.parse import urlsplit
+
+from dotenv import load_dotenv
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, REDACTED, field_validator
+
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def resolve_path(value: str | Path) -> Path:
+    """Resolve configured and CLI paths against the repository, not the caller."""
+    path = Path(value).expanduser()
+    return (REPO_ROOT / path).resolve() if not path.is_absolute() else path.resolve()
+
+
+class Settings(BaseModel):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid", hide_input_in_errors=True)
+
+    openai_api_key: REDACTED
+    openai_model: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    raw_data_dir: Path
+    data_dir: Path
+    output_dir: Path
+    cache_dir: Path
+    neo4j_uri: str
+    neo4j_user: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    neo4j_password: REDACTED
+    api_host: str
+    api_port: int = Field(ge=1, le=65535)
+    api_base_url: str
+    streamlit_server_address: str
+    streamlit_server_port: int = Field(ge=1, le=65535)
+
+    @field_validator("neo4j_uri")
+    @classmethod
+    def graph_uri(cls, value: str) -> str:
+        parsed = urlsplit(value)
+        if parsed.scheme not in {"bolt", "bolt+s", "bolt+ssc", "neo4j", "neo4j+s", "neo4j+ssc"} or not parsed.hostname:
+            raise ValueError("NEO4J_URI must be a Bolt or Neo4j URL")
+        if parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+            raise ValueError("NEO4J_URI must not contain credentials, query, or fragment")
+        if parsed.port is not None and not 1 <= parsed.port <= 65535:
+            raise ValueError("NEO4J_URI port out of range")
+        return value
+
+    @field_validator("api_base_url")
+    @classmethod
+    def http_origin(cls, value: str) -> str:
+        parsed = urlsplit(value)
+        if parsed.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parsed.hostname:
+            raise ValueError("API_BASE_URL must be an HTTP(S) URL")
+        if parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+            raise ValueError("API_BASE_URL must not contain credentials, query, or fragment")
+        if parsed.port is not None and not 1 <= parsed.port <= 65535:
+            raise ValueError("API_BASE_URL port out of range")
+        return value.rstrip("/")
+
+
+def load_settings() -> Settings:
+    load_dotenv(REPO_ROOT / ".env", override=False)
+
+    port = os.environ.get("API_PORT", "8000")
+    return Settings(
+        openai_api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY", ""),
+        openai_model=os.environ.get("OPENAI_MODEL", "gpt-4o-mini"),
+        raw_data_dir=resolve_path(os.environ.get("BMW_RAW_DATA_DIR", "./BMW-Data")),
+        data_dir=resolve_path(os.environ.get("BMW_DATA_DIR", "./var/processed")),
+        output_dir=resolve_path(os.environ.get("BMW_OUTPUT_DIR", "./var/exports")),
+        cache_dir=resolve_path(os.environ.get("BMW_CACHE_DIR", "./var/cache")),
+        neo4j_uri=os.environ.get("NEO4J_URI", "bolt://localhost:7687"),
+        neo4j_user=os.environ.get("NEO4J_USER", "neo4j"),
+        neo4j_password=os.environ.get("NEO4J_PASSWORD", "bmwpassword"),
+        api_host=os.environ.get("API_HOST", "0.0.0.0"),
+        api_port=port,
+        api_base_url=os.environ.get("API_BASE_URL", f"http://localhost:{port}"),
+        streamlit_server_address=os.environ.get("STREAMLIT_SERVER_ADDRESS", "0.0.0.0"),
+        streamlit_server_port=os.environ.get("STREAMLIT_SERVER_PORT", "8501"),
+    )
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def get_settings() -> Settings:
+    return load_settings()

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+from openpyxl import Workbook
+from pydantic import ValidationError
+
+from config import load_settings
+
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+
+
+class ConfigurationTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_root_dotenv_paths_and_port_interpolation(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPO_ROOT) as temp_dir:
+            root = Path(temp_dir)
+            (root / ".env").write_text(
+                "BMW_RAW_DATA_DIR=./inputs\n"
+                "BMW_DATA_DIR=./converted\n"
+                "API_PORT=8123\n"
+                "API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:${API_PORT}\n"
+                "REDACTED",
+                encoding="utf-8",
+            )
+            with patch("config.REPO_ROOT", root), patch.dict(os.environ, {}, clear=True):
+                settings = load_settings()
+
+        self.assertEqual(settings.raw_data_dir, root / "inputs")
+        self.assertEqual(settings.data_dir, root / "converted")
+        self.assertEqual(settings.api_port, 8123)
+        self.assertEqual(settings.api_base_url, "http://localhost:8123")
+        self.assertEqual(settings.neo4j_password.get_secret_value(), "synthetic-password")
+        self.assertNotIn("synthetic-password", repr(settings))
+        self.assertEqual(settings.openai_api_key.get_secret_value(), "")
+
+    def test_process_overrides_win_over_dotenv_and_interpolation(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPO_ROOT) as temp_dir:
+            root = Path(temp_dir)
+            (root / ".env").write_text(
+                "API_PORT=8123\n"
+                "API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:${API_PORT}\n"
+                "REDACTED",
+                encoding="utf-8",
+            )
+            with patch("config.REPO_ROOT", root), patch.dict(os.environ, {
+                "API_PORT": "8345", "NEO4J_PASSWORD": "REDACTED",
+                "BMW_DATA_DIR": str(root / "explicit-output"),
+            }, clear=True):
+                settings = load_settings()
+
+        self.assertEqual(settings.api_port, 8345)
+        self.assertEqual(settings.api_base_url, "http://localhost:8345")
+        self.assertEqual(settings.neo4j_password.get_secret_value(), "REDACTED")
+        self.assertEqual(settings.data_dir, root / "explicit-output")
+
+    def test_invalid_graph_uri_and_ports_fail_configuration(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPO_ROOT) as temp_dir:
+            root = Path(temp_dir)
+            invalid_values = (
+                {"NEO4J_URI": "http://localhost:7474"},
+                {"NEO4J_URI": "REDACTED"},
+                {"NEO4J_URI": "bolt://localhost:70000"},
+                {"API_PORT": "not-a-port"},
+                {"API_PORT": "0"},
+                {"STREAMLIT_SERVER_PORT": "70000"},
+            )
+            for environment in invalid_values:
+                with self.subTest(environment=environment):
+                    with patch("config.REPO_ROOT", root), patch.dict(os.environ, environment, clear=True):
+                        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError):
+                            load_settings()
+
+    def test_validation_errors_do_not_echo_uri_credentials(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPO_ROOT) as temp_dir:
+            root = Path(temp_dir)
+            for variable, scheme in (("NEO4J_URI", "bolt"), ("API_BASE_URL", "http")):
+                with self.subTest(variable=variable):
+                    with patch("config.REPO_ROOT", root), patch.dict(os.environ, {
+                        variable: f"{scheme}://user:synthetic-uri-secret@localhost:7687",
+                    }, clear=True):
+                        with self.assertRaises(ValidationError) as error:
+                            load_settings()
+
+                    message = str(error.exception)
+                    self.assertIn("must not contain credentials", message)
+                    self.assertNotIn("synthetic-uri-secret", message)
+
+    def test_preprocess_cli_uses_configured_paths_from_another_directory(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPO_ROOT) as temp_dir:
+            root = Path(temp_dir)
+            raw_dir = root / "inputs"
+            raw_dir.mkdir()
+            output_dir = root / "converted"
+            workbook = Workbook()
+            sheet = workbook.active
+            sheet.title = "Feedback_Explorer"
+            sheet.append(("ID", "Customer Feedback", "Model", "Country", "Feedback Type"))
+            sheet.append(("CLI-1", "Synthetic CLI feedback.", "G70", "US", "DTU"))
+            workbook.save(raw_dir / "G70_feedback.xlsx")
+
+            environment = {
+                **os.environ,
+                "BMW_RAW_DATA_DIR": str(raw_dir.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)),
+                "BMW_DATA_DIR": str(output_dir.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)),
+                "OPENAI_API_KEY": "",
+            }
+            result = subprocess.run([
+                sys.executable, str(REPO_ROOT / "pipeline" / "00_preprocess.py"),
+                "--required-kind", "feedback",
+                "--required-document-kind", "document",
+            ], cwd=root, env=environment, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
+
+            # A missing required PDF is correctly partial, but the configured
+            # workbook and destination must still resolve against the repo.
+            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1, result.stderr)
+            manifest = json.loads((output_dir / "manifest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+            self.assertEqual(manifest["counts"]["feedback_comments"], 1)
+            self.assertEqual(manifest["missing_kinds"], [])
+            self.assertEqual(manifest["missing_document_kinds"], ["document"])
+            self.assertFalse((root / raw_dir.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)).exists())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
